main_measure.name: ordinary t of the mean of (excess 2-bar return x forecast/10) on 20:00 UTC decision bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 and supporting slope > 0; reject if t <= -2; otherwise inconclusive; at least 200 decision bars with forecast > 0

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of excess 2-bar return on forecast, decision bars with forecast > 0

decided_by: The main t is 2 or more and the supporting slope is above 0.
reading: Coming hour is taken as the bar's start hour + 1; the fall is the sign of the raw fall24 value (the 24-bar price return where it is not recorded); the main mean pools all 20:00 decision bars, including those with forecast 0 (product 0); the coin mean 2-bar return is pooled over all its windows on a grid at positions 0, 2, 4, ... of each window; a shortfall of the plan's 200-bar minimum is reported as 'not observable'.
